lead: Your coffee, leveled up. A smooth medium-roast Arabica ground coffee with organic lion's mane and chaga mushrooms blended in — for focused, jitter-smooth energy and a daily dose of antioxidant and immune support. Dark chocolate, nutty, full-bodied. You'd never know there were mushrooms in it.
note: 34 cups · Medium Roast · 12 oz (340 g) · ships in 1–2 days

science.title: Why put mushrooms in coffee?
science.text: Coffee gives you energy — but lion's mane and chaga make it work smarter. Lion's mane is the 'focus mushroom', traditionally used to support memory and clear thinking, which pairs beautifully with caffeine for sharper, calmer energy. Chaga is one of the most antioxidant-rich foods there is, adding daily immune support. Blended into a smooth medium-roast Arabica, it tastes like great coffee — dark chocolate, nutty, full-bodied — not mushrooms.

format.title: Brews like the coffee you love
format.text: No separate powders to stir, no earthy aftertaste — just ground coffee you brew exactly as you always do. The 5% lion's mane and 5% chaga disappear into a smooth, full-bodied cup.
list: — 1 tbsp (10 g) per cup = coffee + lion's mane + chaga

facts.side_text: 90% roasted Arabica with 5% organic lion's mane and 5% organic chaga — virtually zero calories (6 per cup), no sugar, no additives. Made in the USA — 12 oz (340 g), about 34 cups.
facts.warning: Contains caffeine. Not recommended for those sensitive to caffeine, pregnant or nursing women, or under 18. If you take blood thinners or diabetes medication or have a medical condition, consult a physician before use.

steps.title: One tbsp per cup
steps.text: Use about 1 tablespoon (10 g) of grounds per cup — adjust to taste.

steps.title: Brew your way
steps.text: Brew it however you like — drip, French press, pour-over or moka pot. It works in all of them.

steps.title: Enjoy in the morning
steps.text: Best in the morning or early afternoon — it's real coffee, so go easy on it late in the day.
